text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! A blood-pumping battle like 
no other! If paradise exists, it is right 
here! The Goddess of Fate? She's weeping 
right beside the Goddess of History!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Destruction serves only to create. To defy 
reason, a new myth is required. Come, wipe 
your tears—and share this celebratory 
toast with me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For the future someone dreamed of, and 
that everyone dreams of. —Cheers!
